item.title: 中国、米政府機関のディープシーク排除に反発 「首脳間の合意無視」
item.description: [北京 ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京　２０日　ロイター] - 中国商務省は２０日、米政府が中国の人工知能（ＡＩ）企業「ディープシーク」のモデルを連邦政府機関のＩＴシステムから排除するよう命じたことについて、中国企業の利益を損ない、両国首脳間で合意された事項を無視するものだと批判した。

同省は声明で、米国に対し「直ちに誤った措置を是正し、関連する差別的な制限措置を撤回する」よう要求。中国政府は事態の推移を注視し、自国の利益を守るために「必要なあらゆる措置を講じる」と述べた。

さらに、今回の命令に「強い不満を表明し、断固として反対する」とした上で、米国が米中首脳間の合意内容を履行し、中国と「同じ方向で」協力し、米中のＡＩ対話メカニズムを十分に活用することを期待していると述べた。

国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）は１９日、米政府の民生部門のＩＴシステムから、ディープシークの製品および同社製モデルを使用した第三者サービスの排除を命じた。同省は、ディープシークのモデルは「複数の脅威の経路」をもたらすと指摘。米政府職員や取引業者が使用した場合、「機密データが中国に流出する可能性がある」との懸念を示した。

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-クアルコム、世界で人員削減へ 業績評価踏まえ11月から通知
item.description:
Aditya Soni Jaspreet Singh
[２０日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手クアルコムは年次の人事評価...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
EXCLUSIVE-クアルコム、世界で人員削減へ　業績評価踏まえ11月から通知 0:32 配信

2025年8月25日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

Aditya Soni　Jaspreet Singh

[２０日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手クアルコムは年次の人事評価を踏まえ、世界で「業績に焦点を当てた人員削減」を実施する。クリスティアーノ・アモン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）から従業員に宛てたメモをロイターが入手した。通知は１１月に始まる予定。

アモン氏は、今回の削減は「より強い業績重視の企業文化」を築く取り組みの一環であり、同社が「期待された成果を継続的に上げられなかった状況に対処するため」のものだと説明。人員削減に当たっては事業の優先事項、組織のニーズ、スキル、専門性を考慮するとした。

メモは影響を受ける人員規模には言及しておらず、ロイターも削減規模を直ちに特定できなかった。

クアルコムはコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。昨年９月時点の世界の従業員数は約５万２０００人で、大半がフルタイム従業員。

今年は主要市場でメモリー価格の高騰が需要を圧迫し、クアルコムは民生用電子機器の販売低迷に見舞われている。

同社株の年初来の上昇率は１．５％にとどまる。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は１２％超、フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（ＳＯＸ）は約６０％、それぞれ上昇している。

item.title: US coaxing refiners to produce more diesel as prices surge, energy officials say
item.description: Two top US Energy Department officials said on Tuesday they were working with refiners at home and abroad to boost fuel output as a diesel shortage has raised prices, driving dissatisfaction among voters with the White House ahead of the November midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Nathan Crooks, Arathy Somasekhar
item.content:encoded: Two top US Energy Department officials said on Tuesday they were working with refiners at home and abroad to boost fuel output as a diesel shortage has raised prices, driving dissatisfaction among voters with the White House ahead of the November [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. Diesel prices have jumped to record highs because of disruptions from the Iran war and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries . Retail diesel prices averaged about $6.32 a gallon on Tuesday, according to motorist group AAA. The Trump administration has taken several steps to try to lower fuel prices that have surged since the start of the Iran war on February 28, including relaxing restrictions on Russian diesel exports, invoking the Defense Production Act to boost output and allowing commercial vehicles to run on red-dyed diesel normally limited to off-road equipment. Diesel is critical to the global economy, powering much of the transport, agriculture and heavy industry that underpin global trade and economic activity. The high cost of fuel has soured voters on US President Donald Trump's stewardship of the economy, with 36% approving of Trump on that issue, according to the most recent Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll . "We are talking about reopening every refinery we can," Energy Secretary Chris Wright said in Houston. "There are dialogues there, and that's a tough challenge. I'm not saying all these are going to happen." DIFFICULT TO RAISE US OUTPUT US refineries are running near full capacity, and with several facilities shutting in recent years, there is little leeway to quickly boost domestic output, analysts say. [USN:L6N3Q20MK TEXT:"Refinery expansions"] are capital intensive and take months, if not years, to complete depending on the complexity of the additions. Wright said the US is also working with India to increase refining output there to bring products to global markets. American Petroleum Institute CEO Mike Sommers told Reuters on the sidelines of an energy forum in Titusville, Pennsylvania that US refiners are running at 95% to 100% of capacity. He said they are putting off planned maintenance because of high prices. “The American refiners are doing everything they can,” Sommers said. He said that using the Defense Production Act to restart idled plants, as the administration has floated, would require a lot of capital. Last week, Vice President JD Vance said the administration would use the Defense Production Act to [USN:L6N45Z1BU TEXT:"expand capacity"] of a Texas refinery owned by Delek US Holdings (DK.N) . Trump signed legislation last year that included $1 billion in Defense Production Act funding for energy-related projects deemed critical to national security. Wright said there was "more to do" on refining and the Defense Production Act but did not provide additional details. Sommers singled out China's spare refining capacity, saying their government is currently barring diesel exports. Beijing “is really going to be the key if we’re going to get long-term prices down,” he said. A spokesperson for the Chinese embassy in Washington said the key to resolving the issue is to achieve a ceasefire in Iran. "China stands ready to maintain communication with all sides to jointly safeguard global energy security and keep industrial and supply chains stable," the spokesperson added. PUSH FOR EUROPEAN DIESEL Trump [USN:S0N43U024 TEXT:"temporarily waived sanctions"] this month on Russian diesel in an attempt to lower prices. Russian diesel will likely move to New England, if it moves to the US at all, Wright said. Already, cargoes from Russia are returning to their[USN:L6N4660PS TEXT:" traditional destinations"] after the US suspended sanctions, with two tankers signaling trips to Turkey and Brazil in recent days, Reuters reported on Tuesday. The Trump administration has also been pushing Europe to release more fuel to balance global markets. "We are working with our friends ... to find new and innovative ways to get more throughput" through refineries, said Energy Department Under Secretary Kyle Haustveit at the Drake Forum in Titusville. While the Trump administration has pushed Europe to release 50 million barrels of diesel, an agreement by industrialized nations fell short of that target. The Paris-based International Energy Agency said last week it would speed the release of crude and oil product volumes pledged in March, including more than 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible. Fatih Birol, chief of the IEA, which coordinates industrialized nations' releases of oil from emergency stocks, said on Tuesday the [USN:L6N4660MV TEXT:"group is ready"] to coordinate more oil releases by member countries if needed.

item.title: 英、サウジ防空支援へ戦闘機派遣 フーシ派攻勢に対応
item.description: [ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - 英国防省は２０日、空軍のタイフーン戦闘機をサウジアラビアに派遣し、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻勢に対応した防空任務に当たると明らかにした。サウジ政府からの要請に基づくもので、フーシ派への攻撃は行わないという。

フーシ派はここ数週間で、サウジの石油施設などに対する攻撃を強めている。英国は、攻撃が地域の安定を脅かし、エネルギー供給や貿易の混乱を招く恐れがあると警戒している。

ストリーティング国防相は声明で「サウジに対するフーシ派の攻撃継続は卑劣だ」と指摘。リヤドの空港が標的となったことなどに情勢の悪化具合が示されているとし、追加支援を承認したと述べた。「タイフーンはドローンやミサイルからサウジ空域を守る防衛任務に就く」と説明した。今年９月に発表した空中給油に加え、支援を拡大。輸送機や軍事顧問も派遣する。バーナム首相は今月、要請があれば追加支援を検討する用意があると述べていた。

イエメン当局によると、フーシ派は１９日、サウジが支援する暫定政府治安部隊の訓練施設を攻撃し、５８人が死亡した。

ネタニヤフ首相は首相府が発表した声明で「われわれはイラン体制の排除を完遂することにコミットしている」と表明。「この問題についてトランプ大統領と何度も協議しており、一昨日も話し合った」とした。

item.title: ＧＭ株8％安、通期ＥＰＳ予想が市場予想下回る 第3四半期は増益
item.description:
Kalea Hall
[２０日 ロイター] - 米自動車大手ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）の株価が２０日の市場で８％超急...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＭ株8％安、通期ＥＰＳ予想が市場予想下回る　第3四半期は増益 10/20 23:07 配信

2019年1月13日撮影。REUTERS/Rebecca Cook

Kalea Hall

[２０日 ロイター] - 米自動車大手ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）の株価が２０日の市場で８％超急落している。２０日発表した第３・四半期決算は、ピックアップトラックの販売が好調で中核的な利益が大幅に増加した。ただ、通期の１株当たり利益（ＥＰＳ）見通しがアナリスト予想を下回ったほか、今後数カ月はコモディティーコストの上昇とトラック販売の減少による圧迫を見込むと示唆した。

ＧＭは２０２６年通期の一時的な項目を除いた金利・税引き前利益（調整後ＥＢＩＴ）について、従来予想の１４０億─１６０億ドルから１４５億─１５５億ドルへとレンジを狭めた。この結果、通期の１株当たり調整後ＥＰＳ予想は１２．７５─１３．７５ドルとなった。ＧＭ予想の中央値はＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の中央値１３．４１ドルを下回っている。

ＧＭは、主力車種であるシボレー・シルバラードとＧＭＣシエラの刷新版の投入準備に伴い、第４・四半期はトラック納車台数の減少が業績の重しになると見込んでいる。

ポール・ジェイコブソン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は電話会見で「消費者は驚くほど底堅さを維持している。弱さを示す兆候は何も見られない」と述べた。

ただ、ジェイコブソン氏は、特に鉄鋼、アルミニウム、物流について、過去２カ月でコストが急上昇したとも指摘。コモディティー関連費用が足元の水準から緩和しなければ、来年のＧＭの最終利益を２０億ドル押し下げる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ＪＰモルガンは、コスト上昇に加え、高価格帯トラックに偏重した販売構成を維持できるかどうかの不透明感を踏まえ、投資家は「現時点では見通しへの確信に疑問を抱く可能性が高い」との見方を示した。

第３・四半期の調整後ＥＢＩＴは前年同期比２２％増の４１億ドルとなった。１株当たりでは３．７０ドルとなり、ＬＳＥＧのデータに基づくアナリスト予想の３．６３ドルを上回った。

第３・四半期の売上高は前年同期比２．９％増の５００億ドル。北米事業の利益率は、四半期販売台数がわずかに減少したものの、前年同期の６．２％から８．７％に改善した。

大型ピックアップトラックの販売構成比が高まる一方、電気自動車（ＥＶ）の販売が減少し、収益を押し上げた。ＥＶは従来赤字が続いているうえ、トランプ米政権のＥＶ支援撤回を受け、ＧＭはＥＶ販売を縮小している。

ＣＦＲＡのアナリスト、ギャレット・ネルソン氏は、ＧＭが今年、米国でのシェアを落としている点を指摘し、ＧＭがほぼ手がけていないハイブリッド車との競争を背景に挙げた。ＧＭは過去１０年、ハイブリッド車を提供しないと決定しＥＶに全面的に注力してきたが、ハイブリッド車は現在、米国販売の１５％超を占めている。

ＧＭは「今後の道のりはより厳しくなる」としたものの、消費者の底堅い需要が続き、コモディティーや物流分野でのコスト圧力が和らぐことを前提に、来年の業績は改善するとの見通しを改めて示した。

ＧＭ取締役会は、複数年にわたる総額２００億ドルの自社株買いプログラムを承認した。ＧＭは２０２３年以降で約２９５億ドルの自社株を買い戻している。

item.title: Genetic study shows seafarers from Easter Island settled Hawaii
item.description: Oct 20 : It was a difficult, almost incomprehensible, feat. A band of seafarers from Easter Island in the South Pacific set off in double-hulled sailing canoes on a voyage across Earth's largest ocean that ended more than 4,400 miles (7,100 km) away in Hawaii, the only Polynesian island in the Northern Hemisphere.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Genetic study shows seafarers from Easter Island settled Hawaii

FILE PHOTO: Surfers return to the shore as the sun sets over Waikiki in Hawaii, U.S. December 20, 2016. REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque/File Photo

FAST

Oct 20 : It was a difficult, almost incomprehensible, feat. A band of seafarers from Easter Island in the South Pacific set off in double-hulled sailing canoes on a voyage across Earth's largest ocean that ended more than 4,400 miles (7,100 km) away in Hawaii, the only Polynesian island in the Northern Hemisphere. But this oceanic odyssey centuries ago was no myth. New genetic research has determined that Native Hawaiians are genetically most closely related to the people of Easter Island, also called Rapa Nui. "Using whole genomes, our algorithms can find DNA sequences matching perfectly between individuals on different islands, the legacy of common ancestors. From these data we can create family trees of the islands," said Stanford University computational geneticist Alexander Ioannidis, co-senior author of the study published in the journal Science.  The findings point to a founding population of people from Easter Island arriving in Hawaii as the first humans to settle the lush volcanic island chain.

The data indicated that the people who settled Easter Island arrived there in the 1200s after journeying from Mangareva island in French Polynesia, more than 1,500 miles (2,400 km) away, and that a subset of them subsequently set off for Hawaii. That voyage likely occurred in the same century, Ioannidis said. "We examined shared segments of DNA, genetic variation and thousands of reconstructed family trees. In 61 per cent of those trees, Hawaii and Rapa Nui were paired together. We checked it four different ways because, frankly, we were dumbfounded and couldn't believe it ourselves at first," said genome scientist and study co-senior author Keolu Fox of the University of California, San Diego. It would have been an incredible journey, Ioannidis said. "In their canoes, they brought with them plants that they would need on the newly settled island, and they included bananas, taro and sweet potato, as well as animals like the chicken. It is believed that the Polynesians would embark on these voyages across thousands of miles of ocean in order to discover new islands rich in resources and land to settle," Ioannidis said. The researchers pieced together these long-ago journeys based on genetic data revealing the relatedness of present-day people from various Polynesian islands, analyzing DNA from more than 1,000 Polynesian people. These included 317 Native Hawaiians, 12 Rapa Nui and 8 Mangarevans, as well as others from the Society, Tuamotu, Marquesas, Austral, Samoan and Tongan islands. The genetic data showed Mangarevan ancestry was second only to Easter Island ancestry for Native Hawaiians. MONUMENTAL SEA CROSSINGS The researchers attribute these monumental sea crossings to an ultravoyaging population they call Holomoana Nui, the Hawaiian phrase for "great ocean voyaging," with Hawaii as the last destination reached. They were the greatest voyaging community in human history, according to Fox, who is a Native Hawaiian. "Polynesians were exploring and settling the Pacific centuries before Europeans began their celebrated voyages of discovery," Fox said. "Perhaps it's time to rethink who we call explorers." Using genetic data, the researchers previously tracked how Polynesian voyagers reached a succession of islands over a period of centuries in one of the most impressive settlement feats in human history, but that study traced them only as far as Easter Island. THE FOUNDING OF TAHITI The new study included a detailed genomic analysis of people from Tahiti, one of the Society Islands and the locale for which the researchers had the most genomes. They were able to estimate the size and date of the founding generation — roughly 800 people reaching Tahiti around the year 1070. "Since the voyage to Hawaii was much longer, we would expect its founding population size to have been no larger and likely smaller," Ioannidis said. Native Hawaiians and Easter Islanders share many cultural traits found among eastern Polynesians, including a similar Austronesian language and similar foods, Ioannidis said. The study has implications for disease risk among Native Hawaiians and other Polynesians due to genetic bottlenecks called "founder effects." These arise when a small portion of a population separates and founds a new population, as the Polynesians did each time they ventured to and settled on a new island. This narrowing of the gene pool can amplify the frequency of some rare genetic variants sometimes related to diseases, while others vanish entirely, Ioannidis said. The Polynesians repeated the pattern of settling on new lands, intensifying the effect. "Repeated founder effects concentrated rare disease-associated variants in Polynesian populations. We identified variants linked to kidney disease and blindness that occur at surprisingly high frequencies in French Polynesia," Fox said. Founder effects have been extensively studied in certain populations including the Amish, Ashkenazi Jews and Finns, leading to standard screenings for certain genetic conditions for them. "Why not Hawaiians?" Fox asked.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米一戸建て着工、9月4.6％減 許可件数は3年半ぶり低水準
item.description: [ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が２０日発表した９月の住宅着工件数（季節調整済み）は、住宅建設の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米一戸建て着工、9月4.6％減　許可件数は3年半ぶり低水準 10/20 22:42 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスの住宅に掲げられた「売家」の看板。１月撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake

[ワシントン　２０日　ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が２０日発表した９月の住宅着工件数（季節調整済み）は、住宅建設の大部分を占める一戸建てが年率換算で前月比４．６％減の８５万９０００戸と、２０２５年９月以来、約１年ぶりの低水準となった。一戸建て住宅の建設許可件数は４．０％減の８４万５０００戸と、２３年３月以来の低水準に落ち込んだ。住宅ローン金利の上昇が需要を抑制したことから着工・許可件数ともに大幅に減少し、住宅投資が第３・四半期に再び減少基調に戻ったことを示唆した。

一戸建て着工件数は前年同月比では２．６％増加した。地域別では、前月比で南部、中西部、西部で減少した一方、北東部では増加した。

一戸建て住宅の建設許可件数は前年同月比で４．８％減少。地域別では、前月比で北東部、中西部、南部で減少し、西部は横ばいとなった。

変動の大きい５戸以上の集合住宅着工件数は７．２％減の３４万９０００戸。 前年同月比では２５．９％減少した。

全体の住宅着工件数は５．２％減の１２２万１０００戸。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１３０万５０００戸だった。前年同月比で７．４％減少した。

集合住宅の建設許可件数は５．９％増の５０万３０００戸。

全体の住宅建設許可件数は０．２％減の１４０万戸。エコノミスト予想は１３９万５０００戸だった。前年同月比では３．０％減少した。

住宅ローン金利はここ数週間で急上昇しており、米連邦住宅貸付抵当公社（フレディマック） のデータによると、先週の３０年固定住宅ローン金利平均は７．４０％と、ほぼ３年ぶりの高水準となった。米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争がインフレをあおる中、借り入れコストの上昇は米国債利回りに連動している。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「住宅着工の低迷は驚くべきことではない。たとえ住宅建設業者が新築住宅を建てたとしても、誰にそれを買う余裕があるだろう」と指摘。「米政権が政策を１８０度転換し、新築住宅の価格をより手頃なものにしない限り、住宅市場は深刻な低迷期に入っていく」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 最終更新: 10/21(水) 0:03 ロイター

item.title: Fed sneezes, but emerging markets aren't catching a cold yet: McGeever
item.description: Emerging markets have developed stronger immune systems. US debt dynamics are deteriorating and the Federal Reserve has started hiking interest rates, yet EM appears under no pressure to follow suit. The US has sneezed, but EM isn't catching the proverbial cold.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded: Emerging markets have developed stronger immune systems. US debt dynamics are deteriorating and the Federal Reserve has started [USN:L4N3XG141 TEXT:"hiking interest rates"], yet EM appears under no pressure to follow suit. The US has sneezed, but EM isn't catching the proverbial cold. Historically, when the Fed starts tightening policy, emerging economies are forced to hike as well, even if their domestic economies aren’t strong enough to warrant it, due to currency concerns and debt dynamics. This has given rise to another market cliche: the Fed is central banker to the world. But surprisingly resilient economic growth across emerging economies this year, sturdier fiscal fundamentals, and relatively high interest rates and bond yields are offering EM central banks a degree of flexibility. That could allow them to start cutting rates in the next year, or, at the very least, enable them not to follow the Fed in lockstep as it tightens. RATE BUFFER Emerging markets – like their developed peers – are currently beset by a host of risks stemming from geopolitical strife, trade frictions, the energy price shock, and AI bubble fears. But even though some EM countries are particularly vulnerable, either to persistently high energy prices or a sudden, disorderly unwind of the AI trade, the threat of rapidly tightening monetary policy is mostly absent. This is largely because policy rates are already elevated across much of EM. The weighted average 10-year emerging bond yield at the end of September was around its highest point in five years at nearly 6.45%, according to State Street. Average inflation-adjusted EM yields, meanwhile, are also historically high, close to 3%. Lofty policy rates have helped restore EM central bank credibility, support exchange rates, and create a real rate buffer. Bank of America strategists say EM rates at the front end of the curve have "materially" overshot to such an extent that implied policy rates next year will be in restrictive territory in all major emerging economies except China. "Widespread tightening seems unlikely," State Street strategists wrote earlier this month. While EMs look surprisingly calm, robust, and attractive – with some notable exceptions like [USN:L4N466046 TEXT:"Indonesia "]– the same cannot be said of their developed-market peers. While many emerging countries appear to be strengthening their economic fundamentals, investors’ concern over the fiscal trajectory in the [USN:L6N45O0TM TEXT:"US"], [USN:SPN45900X TEXT:"Japan"], much of the [USN:L6N4660NP TEXT:"euro zone"], and the UK has sent yields across the industrialized world to the highest in decades. PIQUE INTEREST Investors are positioning accordingly. A JPMorgan survey of investors at the International Monetary Fund/World Bank meetings in Bangkok last week showed that 33% favor EM stocks, compared with 26% who prefer developed market equities. Bank of America's latest fund manager survey shows that a net 34% of those polled are overweight in EM stocks, down slightly from 38% in September, but hardly bearish. Could investors be too optimistic about EM? Perhaps. The long EM equities position is one of the most crowded trades in BofA's survey, suggesting there is still plenty of room for it to be trimmed further. Of course, EM bond yields are higher because EM debt is still a riskier proposition than developed market offerings, especially traditionally "risk-free" US Treasuries. But it is notable that realized volatility in EM bonds has been lower than that of Treasuries for a few years, according to iShares benchmark EM bond (EMB.O) and Treasuries ETFs (TLT.O) . To be sure, emerging economies' debt burden is rising, narrowing the gap with highly indebted advanced economies. But the average EM debt-to-GDP ratio still appears manageable. The IMF projects an overall EM debt-to-GDP ratio this year of 77.2%, rising to 86.2% in five years, compared with forecasts for advanced economies of 108.2% this year, rising to 114.8%. While the debt-to-GDP risk threshold in EM countries is lower because these economies are typically less resilient, few alarm bells are being rung. Indeed, the rise in EM debt has been quite gradual, suggesting policymakers are determined to keep it under control. NOT A MONOLITH Rising Fed rates and US market turbulence will always affect EM economies, especially those carrying more dollar-denominated debt. And there will always be idiosyncratic EM distress stories, like we’re currently seeing in Indonesia. But events like this typically bear little relation to the broader emerging market narrative. Removing Indonesia could actually make EM equity indices more attractive to investors. It’s also important to remember that the EM universe is wide, and the differences between economies are vast. Policymakers in some EM countries where core inflation is relatively low and expectations are anchored, like Brazil and Mexico, are cutting rates, and some, like South Africa and South Korea, are raising them to offset currency weakness or inflation. Others may prefer to keep their options open. But the Fed doesn't appear to be calling the EM tune like it used to, and if the record attendance at Barclays' EM Conference in Bangkok last week is any guide, that's music to investors' ears. (The opinions expressed here are those of the author, a columnist for Reuters) Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI), your essential new source for global financial commentary. item.title: ドイツ、防衛・半導体・ＡＩに重点投資へ 首相が投資家に表明
item.description: [ベルリン ２０日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は２０日、投資家に向けて演説し、長期的な生産性と経済的な自立性を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドイツ、防衛・半導体・ＡＩに重点投資へ　首相が投資家に表明 10/20 21:37 配信

ベルリンで開催された「Invest in Germanyサミット」で演説するメルツ首相、20日撮影 REUTERS/Lisi Niesner

[ベルリン ２０日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は２０日、投資家に向けて演説し、長期的な生産性と経済的な自立性を高めるため、防衛や半導体、人工知能（ＡＩ）などの分野に重点的に投資していると述べた。

ベルリンでのイベントで「皆さんにとって最善の事業環境を整えることが目標だ」と語り、欧州最大の経済国であるドイツへの投資を呼びかけた。イベントにはエネルギー企業バルカン・エナジーや防衛企業ヘルシングなどの代表者が出席した。

メルツ氏は、成長の加速や海外からの直接投資の増加、スタートアップ設立の増加を挙げ、政策の効果が既に経済に表れていると述べた。

またドイツ企業が２０２８年までに８０００億ユーロ（８９８４億ドル）超を投資すると約束した「メード・フォー・ジャーマニー」構想を紹介した。

欧州の経済統合が進めば企業が欧州連合（ＥＵ）の単一市場を活用しやすくなると指摘。欧州共通の企業制度「ＥＵ Ｉｎｃ．」をできるだけ早く導入すると約束した。

技術競争力を強化する幅広い取り組みの一環として、ドイツは３０年までにＡＩの計算能力を４倍に引き上げることを目指していると述べた。

この目標を後押しするため、ＡＩ規制が「実現する前に道を閉ざすのではなく、道を開くもの」となるよう、自ら「欧州レベルで関与している」と語った。

item.title: ＩＥＡ、石油備蓄の追加放出にいつでも対応可能＝事務局長
item.description:
Seher Dareen
[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）のビロル事務局長は２０日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＩＥＡ、石油備蓄の追加放出にいつでも対応可能＝事務局長 10/20 21:35 配信

国際エネルギー機関のロゴ、パリで2023年撮影 REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier/File Photo

Seher Dareen

[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）のビロル事務局長は２０日、加盟国の緊急石油備蓄を追加放出する必要が生じた場合、ＩＥＡはいつでも対応できると述べた。

ＩＥＡは先週、３月に表明された過去最大規模の緊急石油備蓄放出のうち、未放出分の供給を前倒しすることを決めた。この一環として２０００万バレルを超える軽油をできるだけ早く放出し、供給を増やして価格高騰を抑える。

ビロル氏は英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズがロンドンで主催した会議で、追加放出の可能性を問われ、「必要になり、加盟国が実行に移す時だと判断すれば、ＩＥＡとしていつでも対応できる」と述べた。

「軽油をできるだけ早く供給できるよう取り組んでいる」と語ったが、２０００万バレルの放出の具体的な時期は示さなかった。「放出量と時期は各国の判断や冬場の市場情勢次第だ」とした。

ＩＥＡは先進国による緊急石油備蓄の放出を調整している。３月には価格高騰を受け、加盟国が原油と石油製品の計４億バレル超の放出を表明していた。ビロル氏によると、加盟国はこれまでに４億バレルの８０％を放出した。

France’s fiscal crisis is nearing its breaking point

With debt approaching 120% of GDP and borrowing costs rising, France faces mounting pressure to rein in its deficit, but pension reform and spending cuts remain politically fraught ahead of the 2027 election, The Editorial Board writes for Bloomberg.

Bloomberg Editors

20 October, 2026 04:43 pm IST

Text Size: A- A+

-->

F rance’s crisis keeps getting more extreme, spilling over the weekend into broader protests that precipitated hundreds of millions of euros in damage and nearly 2,400 arrests. The country’s leaders are rightly focused on curtailing the violence. Yet as they seek ways to placate a frustrated populace, they must be careful not to make a bad fiscal situation worse.

It’s hard to overstate how dire France’s finances have become, particularly now that worried investors have pushed its 10-year bond yields to almost 5%. If borrowing costs remain this high, the interest rate the government pays will soon exceed the economy’s nominal growth rate. As a result, just stabilizing sovereign debt — currently about 120% of gross domestic product, among the highest in Europe — could require running a sustained primary budget surplus of as much as 2% of GDP. That’s a feat France hasn’t achieved since the 1970s.

The politics of achieving the necessary deficit reduction, estimated to be at least €125 billion by 2032, could hardly be more fraught. Among potential savings and revenue measures, pension reform stands out: Increasing the retirement age to 65 — still below the norm among western European peers — could reap about €18 billion. Yet when President Emmanuel Macron in 2023 pushed through an (ultimately postponed) increase from 62 to 64, the move triggered some of the country’s largest-ever protests — albeit rivaled in violence by the weekend’s events — and contributed to the far-right National Rally party’s success in 2024 elections.

Show Full Article

With presidential elections coming next year, there’s even less appetite for prudence. The current minority government’s 2027 budget proposal, which would reduce the deficit by about €28 billion, faces stiff opposition. National Rally’s Marine Le Pen, who leads national polling for the next presidential election, sought to calm bond markets with a pledge of fiscal consolidation that contrasts sharply with the tax cuts and spending promises in her platform. Meanwhile, left-wing candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon, whose statements have been blamed for inflaming protesters, proposed simply canceling more than €500 billion in French public debt held by its central bank — an absurdity that, even if possible, would serve only to spook markets more.

Eventually, the nation’s leaders will have to recognize that there’s no alternative to boring, unpleasant budget discipline. The longer that takes, the greater the damage will be.

France’s malaise places it on a collision course with the broader European Union. The longer it delays serious reform, the more precarious its finances will become as it takes on more debt at higher yields. If investors ultimately refuse to lend, the EU and the European Central Bank will face a dilemma: Organize a bailout or let the bloc’s second-largest economy descend into financial chaos. The best-case scenario would entail imposing austerity measures on France potentially harsher than what’s now needed to stabilize its debt. The worst would be an acute crisis involving a French default, bank runs and possibly a breakup of the euro.

If France’s current minority government can’t act, hopefully the next election will produce leadership capable of delivering the difficult reform the country needs. Even populists have been known to act responsibly when confronted with the immutable facts of public finance. There’s no better way out.

item.title: Portugal housing protesters return to squares, vow to press on
item.description: Thousands of protesters returned to two central squares in Lisbon and Porto on Tuesday and vowed to press on with demonstrations against Portugal's deepening housing crisis, hours after police cleared tent camps before dawn and made 55 arrests.
item.dc:creator: Sergio Goncalves, Miguel Pereira
item.content:encoded: Thousands of protesters returned to two central squares in Lisbon and Porto on Tuesday and vowed to press on with demonstrations against Portugal's deepening housing crisis, hours after police cleared tent camps before dawn and made 55 arrests. A popular assembly in Lisbon voted on Tuesday evening to return to Rossio square and set up tents again on Wednesday. Singer Ana Moura joined protesters there and performed in support of the movement. Organisers said more than 1,000 people had gathered in each square. Police gave no crowd estimate. Debora Miranda, 41, a communications consultant, told Reuters she joined the Rossio square protest to represent generations struggling with soaring costs. "If people don't feel at home, in every sense of the word, they can't move forward with their lives...enough is enough." Activists had occupied Lisbon's Rossio square since Saturday, pitching around 200 tents, and Porto's Dom Joao I square for around 10 days. The camps mirrored housing protests in [USN:L1N45U0F8 TEXT:"neighbouring Spain"], and coincided with unrest over rising living costs in countries such as [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"France"], [USN:L6N46303L TEXT:"Belgium"] and [USN:L8N463090 TEXT:"Italy"]. Shortly before 6 a.m., after warning protesters that the camps were illegal, police launched coordinated operations in both cities. The protesters took down their own tents in Porto while officers cleared Rossio square. Carla Valadao, a spokesperson for the Lisbon camp, described the police operation as "very aggressive". Public Security Police superintendent Sergio Soares told reporters that the eviction had been "calm, proportionate and appropriate, with no police charge". The 55 detainees were later released pending a court appearance in Lisbon on Wednesday. Portugal is grappling with one of Europe's worst housing affordability crises. Purchase prices have more than doubled since 2017 and rents for new leases have nearly doubled. The squeeze is most acute in the major cities, where there has also been opposition to excessive tourism and an influx of so-called digital nomads. The protesters are demanding the centre-right government withdraw a [USN:L6N45M1AX TEXT:"bill"] making evictions easier and ending rent caps on new leases, which passed a first parliamentary reading with the abstention of the far-right Chega party. Jorge Paixao, 19, a history student, called it "a societal crisis", saying his generation needed "the ability to live with dignity, start families and rejuvenate Portugal."

item.title: 台湾9月輸出受注、過去最高 2カ月連続1000億ドル超
item.description:
Faith Hung Jeanny Kao
[台北 ２０日 ロイター] - 台湾経済部が２０日発表した９月の輸出受注額...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
台湾9月輸出受注、過去最高　2カ月連続1000億ドル超 10/20 20:07 配信

台湾・基隆港のコンテナ船、4月19日撮影 REUTERS/Edgar Su

Faith Hung　Jeanny Kao

[台北 ２０日 ロイター] - 台湾経済部が２０日発表した９月の輸出受注額は前年同月比６２．４％増の１１４２億１０００万ドルと、市場予想を上回る伸びとなった。台湾製の人工知能（ＡＩ）向け半導体やハイテク製品に対する世界的な需要に支えられた。

月間の受注額が１０００億ドルを超えるのは２カ月連続。８月は１０３０億ドルと、初めて１０００億ドルを突破した。

伸び率はアナリスト予想の５８．７％を上回り、前年比での増加は２０カ月連続となった。

経済部はＡＩ、高性能コンピューティング、クラウドサービス関連の旺盛な需要が寄与したと説明した。

１０月の輸出受注額は前年比６２．０─６７．０％増を見込む。通年では１兆１０００億ドルに達する可能性があるとした。

先行きについては、地政学リスクや通商政策などの不確実性が今後も世界経済の成長の重しになるとした。一方、台湾は半導体とサーバーのサプライチェーンで中核的な地位を占めており、受注は安定して伸び続けるとの見方を示した。

９月の品目別受注額は、通信機器の受注額が８７．３％増、電子製品は７１．０％増だった。

中国からの受注額は４８．５％増と、８月の４７．７％増から加速した。米国からの受注額は７９．４％増で、前月の８８．９％増から鈍化した。欧州からは６８．０％増、日本からは３５．５％増だった。

item.title: インドネシア株が反発、当局の対策発表でセンチメント改善
item.description:
Ankur Banerjee Stefanno Sulaiman
[シンガポール／ジャカルタ ２０日 ロイター] - ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インドネシア株が反発、当局の対策発表でセンチメント改善 10/20 20:05 配信

インドネシア証券取引所の株価ボード、16日撮影 REUTERS/Ajeng Dinar Ulfiana

Ankur Banerjee　Stefanno Sulaiman

[シンガポール／ジャカルタ ２０日 ロイター] - ２０日のインドネシア株式市場は反発して引けた。指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩが同国をグローバル指数から除外する可能性を警告し、１６日と１９日の２営業日で１４．８％下落、時価総額８２０億ドルが失われる記録的な急落となったことを受け、当局が売りを制限する措置を導入した。

ジャカルタ総合指数は５．６％上昇して引けた。

海外投資家は２６年に入り、インドネシア株から既に５０億ドル近くを引き揚げた。ゴールドマン・サックスは、ＭＳＣＩによる指数からの除外で、パッシブ運用資金５６億ドルが流出する可能性があると推計している。

インドネシア証券取引所（ＩＤＸ）は１９日、ＭＳＣＩとオンライン会合を開いた後、特定の個人や法人などに株式保有が著しく集中している銘柄を、主要指数から除外すると発表した。

オールスプリング・グローバル・インベストメンツのポートフォリオマネジャー、ゲーリー・タン氏は、懸念の一部解消につながるが、国内で反発が起きる可能性を踏まえると実施が鍵になると指摘。「今後、資金フローに新たに生じるリスクは、パッシブファンドよりもアクティブファンドからの流出によるものが大きいと考えている」と語った。

ＭＳＣＩの警告はインドネシアルピアの重荷にもなっている。２０日は１米ドル＝１万７９８０ルピアに小幅上昇したものの、インドネシア中央銀行の金融政策決定を前に、６月に付けた過去最安値の１万８１９０ルピアに近い水準にとどまった。

中銀は２１日に金融政策を発表するが政策金利を据え置くと予想されている。ただ、一部のエコノミストは、年初来で７％下落しているルピアを防衛するため、利上げする可能性を指摘している。

格付け会社フィッチ・レーティングスのソブリン部門ディレクター、ジョージ・シュー氏は、今回の懸念と大幅な相場下落は、同社が３月にインドネシアの格付け見通しを「ネガティブ」に引き下げた際に指摘したリスクを改めて裏付けたと述べた。

「ソブリン格付けの観点からは、検討の発表自体が信用力に直ちに重大な影響を与えるとは予想していない」とする一方、対外的な圧力が政府の借り入れコストを押し上げ、対外的なショックへの備えを弱める可能性があると指摘した。

市場関係者は、株式保有が著しく集中する銘柄を主要指数から除外する措置について、建設的な一歩と評価。ただ、投資家は直接保有や投資信託などの金融商品を通じて、引き続きこれらの企業への投資リスクを抱えることになると指摘した。

証券会社キウム・セクリタス・インドネシアの調査責任者、リザ・カメリア・スルヤナタ氏は「銘柄がジャカルタ総合指数から除外されても、一般投資家が購入する商品の中で集中リスクが蓄積し続けることがないようにしなければならない」と述べた。

item.title: Ormat dominates US geothermal auction in Nevada
item.description: A Trump administration sale of geothermal energy leases in Nevada attracted nearly $4.5 million in winning bids on Tuesday, with developers Ormat and Invenergy as the top spenders.
item.dc:creator: Nichola Groom
item.content:encoded: A Trump administration sale of geothermal energy leases in Nevada attracted nearly $4.5 million in winning bids on Tuesday, with developers Ormat (ORA.N) and Invenergy as the top spenders. The auction drew bids on 60 of the 83 land parcels offered by the Interior Department's Bureau of Land Management, according to sale results posted on a government web site. Those 69 leases cover 186,641 acres in the state. The sale was the fourth of six government geothermal auctions held in 2026 and the first this year in Nevada, which boasts substantial geothermal resources. President Donald Trump's administration has [USN:L1N45D0WR TEXT:"promoted"] [USN:S0N3RO0B5 TEXT:"geothermal"] energy as a promising new source of always-on electricity that can help meet the nation's soaring demand for electricity tied to the expansion of artificial intelligence. Ormat, an established geothermal developer with substantial holdings in Nevada, accounted for nearly half of the auction's total high bids, winning eight parcels on about 20,000 acres for $2.29 million. Ormat also placed the auction's highest bid of $201 per acre for a 3,841-acre parcel in White Pine County in eastern Nevada. Invenergy, an energy and infrastructure developer that has recently expanded into geothermal, picked up nine parcels on 37,000 acres for $694,947. The company was the auction's largest winner by acreage. Glovate LLC was the auction's third-biggest winner, claiming six parcels on 24,000 acres for $570,601. It was not immediately known if Glovate, which was formed in Delaware earlier this month, is tied to an established geothermal company. Some of the acreage offered overlapped with major planned solar energy projects. Two parcels that [USN:L1N46117D TEXT:"overlap"] with NextEra Energy's Sawtooth solar project were won by United Minerals and Mining LLC, another entity established in Delaware this month. Geothermal energy has been produced in the United States since the mid-1900s, but it has recently emerged as one of the fastest-growing areas of the power sector as companies have adapted oil-and-gas drilling techniques to tap heat deep underground. Lease prices at government geothermal auctions have soared this year, but competition at the Nevada auction was concentrated in a handful of parcels. More than a third of the leases sold at the minimum price of $2 an acre.

item.title: Election Interference Is Hard. Messing With Your Mind Is Easy
item.description: You’ve likely heard the ominous what-if scenarios about election disruptions in November: immigration agents or federal troops roaming polling places, federal officials seizing ballots and voting machines, and President Donald Trump issuing an executive order postponing or cancelling the election. Courts and legal experts have given solid reasons that each one of those potential election disruptions is unlikely. But the threats have served their purpose: People are harboring doubts.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-中国ＩＴ3社、エヌビディア新型カードを350億ドル超発注＝関係筋
item.description: [２０日 ロイター] - 字節跳動（バイトダンス）、アリババ、騰訊（テンセント）の中国ＩＴ大手３社が、米半導体大手エヌビ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
EXCLUSIVE-中国ＩＴ3社、エヌビディア新型カードを350億ドル超発注＝関係筋 10/20 19:59 配信

エヌビディアのロゴ、中国国際サプライチェーン博覧会で6月22日撮影 REUTERS/Florence Lo

[２０日 ロイター] - 字節跳動（バイトダンス）、アリババ、騰訊（テンセント）の中国ＩＴ大手３社が、米半導体大手エヌビディアの新型グラフィックスカード「ＲＴＸ ＰＲＯ ５５００」を計３００万枚超発注した。関係者２人が明らかにした。定価ベースの総額は３５０億ドルを超える。

ＲＴＸ ＰＲＯ ５５００はワークステーション向けの半導体だ。エヌビディアの最先端の人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体を使う大規模なデータセンターのコンピューター群に組み込むための製品ではない。最先端の製品より性能は劣るものの、米国の対中輸出規制に適合する同社製品の中では最も高性能な半導体の一つであるため、注文が殺到している。

関係者３人によると、中国企業はＲＴＸ ＰＲＯ ５５００を主にＡＩの推論に使おうとしている。推論とは、学習済みのモデルを動かし、チャットボットの応答などを生成する処理を指す。一般に、大量のデータを使ったモデルの学習ほど計算能力を必要としない。

関係者２人によると、中国ＩＴ大手３社が発注したカードの価格は１枚約１万１４００ドルで、注文総額は３５０億ドルを超える可能性がある。

＜供給ひっ迫＞

関係者３人によると、エヌビディアは中国のＩＴ企業からの需要が生産計画を大幅に上回っているため、注文に応じられる保証はないと顧客や取引先に伝えた。

関係者の１人によると、エヌビディアは取引先に対し、注文数量の５─１０％しか納入できない可能性があると伝えた。別の関係者によると、同社は２０２７年のＲＴＸ ＰＲＯ ５５００の生産枚数が世界全体で最大３００万枚にとどまるとの見通しを示した。関係者２人によると、中国の顧客からの注文は計６００万枚を超えている。

関係者２人によると、エヌビディアが全量の納入を約束できないのは、需要の急増に加え、優先的に生産する製品があるためだ。エヌビディアは２７年以降、台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）で確保する生産能力の多くを、大規模データセンター向けの次世代基盤「ルービン」に振り向ける見通しだという。

両関係者によると、エヌビディアは顧客に対し、ＲＴＸ ＰＲＯ ５５００の初期サンプルを１２月に提供し、２７年第１・四半期に商用出荷を始める予定だと伝えた。

item.title: Dow outperforms as Wall Street rises, healthcare stocks lead gains
item.description: The Dow rose 1% on Tuesday, outperforming the benchmark S&P 500 while the healthcare sector provided Wall Street's biggest boost and technology was its biggest drag.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: The Dow rose 1% on Tuesday, outperforming the benchmark S&P 500 while the healthcare sector provided Wall Street's biggest boost and technology was its biggest drag. Healthcare (.SPXHC) led gains among the S&P 500's 11 major sector indexes, hitting a record high. Eli Lilly (LLY.N) was the S&P 500's biggest index point contributor while UnitedHealth (UNH.N) , Merck & Co (MRK.N) , Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) and Amgen (AMGN.O) helped boost the blue-chip Dow industrials. Declines in megacap stocks pulled down the communication services (.SPLRCL) sector. Energy (.SPNY) shares underperformed as[USN:L1N46601X TEXT:" oil prices"] fell after touching a five-month high. Oil traders were weighing a meeting between the Iranian president and Pakistan's army chief, a US-Iran mediator, against Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and reports of vessel attacks in the Gulf. TECH STOCKS TAKE A BREATHER While the heavyweight technology (.SPLRCT) sector eased 0.3%, it was the biggest index-point drag on the S&P 500 and kept the Nasdaq close to flat. Technology stocks had rebounded on Monday from a selloff last week when investors worried about steep spending and financing costs for AI developments. "Equity investors are still a little skeptical around the AI trade and the ability for some of these companies to monetize their investments, so you're seeing a bit of a rotation into other areas of the market," said Jim Baird, chief investment officer at Plante Moran Financial Advisors, pointing to advances on Tuesday in small caps and healthcare companies. "Investors are looking for other opportunities outside of tech, and healthcare is one of the beneficiaries of that," he said. The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 529.85 points, or 1.02%, to 52,495.88, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 21.84 points, or 0.28%, to 7,712.57 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) lost 6.07 points, or 0.02%, to 26,424.82. The S&P 500 value index (.IVX) rose 0.9% compared with a 0.2% drop in its growth counterpart (.IGX) . The small-cap Russell 2000 index (.RUT) finished up 1.7%. With a 1% gain, the financial services sector (.SPSY) was the S&P 500's second-biggest index point boost. Defensive sectors also outperformed, with real estate (.SPLRCR) adding 1.7% and utilities (.SPLRCU) climbing 1.2%. A 1.7% drop in Netflix, a 1.6% decline in Meta (META.O) and a 1% loss in Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL.O) sent the communication services index down 0.9%. SpaceX (SPCX.O) reported a [USN:L4N4661M0 TEXT:"third-quarter profit"] after the market closed that blew past estimates, boosting its shares 4% in late trading. Netflix (NFLX.O) issued a [USN:L6N4661BU TEXT:"weaker-than-expected forecast"] for fourth-quarter profit after the bell, and its shares fell 6%. Meta and Tesla (TSLA.O) are scheduled to report on Wednesday. General Motors (GM.N) shares sank 6.8% after the automaker [USN:L6N4660PI TEXT:"signaled pressure in coming months"] from higher commodity costs and lower truck sales. 3M (MMM.N) rose 5.8% after the [USN:L4N4651MW TEXT:"company said"] it was expanding its data-center partnership with Amazon (AMZN.O) and issued a warrant to an Amazon subsidiary to purchase 3M common stock worth over $521 million. The industrial conglomerate also raised its full-year profit forecast. Credit reporting firm Equifax (EFX.N) rallied 11.3% after it reported third-quarter profit above analysts' estimates. Hasbro shares (HAS.O) jumped 11.2% after the toymaker [USN:L6N4660PC TEXT:"raised its full-year forecast"] for both overall revenue and its digital gaming business. Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 2.04-to-1 ratio on the NYSE, where there were 114 new highs and 236 new lows. On the Nasdaq, 3,245 stocks rose and 1,608 fell as advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 2.02-to-1 ratio. The S&P 500 posted 22 new 52-week highs and one new low, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 46 new highs and 266 new lows. On US exchanges, 15.91 billion shares changed hands compared with the 17.15 billion average for the last 20 sessions.

item.title: Netflix needs blockbusters to reverse its $135 billion market value wipeout
item.description: Netflix won the fewest Emmy Awards in a decade this year, and the company isn't growing fast enough, according to Co-Chief Executive Officer Ted Sarandos ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Carmen Reinicke Netflix Inc. needs to prove that it can produce hit movies and TV series again to stop a slide that has erased more than $135 billion in market value this year.  The streaming giant reports earnings after the close Tuesday, and investors will likely be more more attuned to what content executives say is coming over the next six months than the company’s third-quarter numbers.  The stock is down 26% in 2026, putting Netflix among the 10 worst performers in the technology-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index and on track for its worst year since 2022, and it’s coming off a 14% decline in September. The reason is no secret to anyone following the company — user engagement has stalled due to a lack of popular content despite heavy spending driven by a crowded, competitive entertainment landscape.   Netflix won the fewest Emmy Awards in a decade this year, and the company isn’t growing fast enough, according to Co-Chief Executive Officer Ted Sarandos.   “The content’s getting very expensive, and there’s just still too many players,” said Ken Mahoney of Mahoney Asset Management. “I think there’s so many better tech stories out there than Netflix that have sticky customers.” Netflix is taking steps to improve its content and raise its audience numbers. On Monday, it announced that the head of its film division, Dan Lin, was leaving, and last week replaced its chief content officer, Bela Bajaria, with Peter Rice, the former chairman of Walt Disney Television. The company also plans to cut about 1,000 positions in various departments globally in a bid to reduce costs. For investors, however, the issue is this earnings report won’t reflect those moves. And even if executives give a solid revenue outlook, it’s unlikely to quell the debate around engagement, according to Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Geetha Raganathan. “A stronger 4Q slate could revive viewing and ads, but investors will want proof that engagement can improve without derailing margin expansion,” she wrote in an Oct. 19 note. The addition of Rice signals a potential pivot toward “more premium, conversation-driving originals and higher 2027 content spending,” she added. Analysts following the company expect it to report a 12% rise in revenue in the third quarter to $12.9 billion, and a 39% jump in earnings to 82 cents a share, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. Its gross margin is expected to be 51%, down slightly from the second quarter.  Wall Street remains generally bullish on the stock, with an average price target of about $92 suggesting a 32% rise over the next 12 months. And while sentiment has weakened, with two analysts putting sell-equivalent ratings on the shares in the last month, bulls see a vibe shift coming. “While total viewing is still weak, quality has improved as reflected in hour/top-10 title and the number of sequels is increasing” through the end of the year, Oppenheimer analysts led by Jason Helfstein wrote in an Oct. 14 note. Three months of US price increases and one month of higher ad rates should give revenue a boost, and the recent headcount reductions will allow for more spending on marketing or content or provide upside to margins, they added.  Management may offer some indications for what it expects in 2027, but the company is unlikely to offer thorough guidance, according to Mark Mahaney of Evercore ISI. He was particularly enthusiastic about Netflix’s recent release of East of Eden. “East of Eden looks very promising to us,” Mahaney wrote in a note to clients on Oct. 16. “Steinbeck is BACK!”  Ad revenue may be more important to investors than audience engagement, according to Wedbush’s Alicia Reese, who says the segment is on track to double to roughly $3 billion in 2026.  “Netflix is actively making changes that should address both its engagement issues and shift dollars from heavy infrastructure to more focused content spend,” Reese wrote in an Oct. 16 note.  One argument for buying the stock would be valuation, considering it’s priced at less than 19 times earnings projected over the next 12 months, the lowest valuation since 2022 and a steep discount to its 10-year average of 49.  That helps explain why KeyBanc Capital Markets analyst Justin Patterson believes the Netflix bear case is already priced into the share price.   “The bear case on slowing engagement and more modest margin expansion is arguably priced in,” he wrote in an Oct. 12 note. “We believe management is aware of these issues, and expect to see corrective action taken across content investment and expense realignment to bolster growth and earnings, and deliver value.”

item.title: Colombian Congress approves budget allocations, cuts funding to peace deal
item.description: Colombian lawmakers approved spending distributions for next year's 634.9 trillion pesos ($201.14 billion) budget on Tuesday, trimming spending linked to a 10-year-old peace agreement and boosting debt service payments.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Colombian lawmakers approved spending distributions for next year's 634.9 trillion pesos ($201.14 billion) budget on Tuesday, trimming spending linked to a 10-year-old peace agreement and boosting debt service payments. The budget, which projects a 2027 fiscal deficit of 9.4% of gross domestic product, is a significant increase from the 555.8 trillion peso budget for this year. The bill allocates 141 trillion pesos, about $45 billion for debt repayment next year, up from about $30 billion allocated in 2026. Neither congress nor the finance ministry had published a complete breakdown of the approved budget by morning on Tuesday and a congressional source told Reuters a final version could take days, as some modifications were approved by only one of the chambers. The bigger budget comes as Colombia, Latin America's fourth-largest economy, struggles to put its public accounts in order. Public debt is expected to rise this year and next, moving the country further from regaining the investment-grade rating it lost in 2021. The government of new right-wing President Abelardo De La Espriella had promised to trim remaining spending for this year and said it plans to propose a 'Rescue Law' to Congress to cut 2027 spending and reduce the fiscal deficit to 7.2% of GDP. Lawmakers in the lower house approved the bill with 112 votes in favor and only one against it, while in the Senate it passed with 57 votes in favor and one against. Lawmakers had until Tuesday night to pass the budget before it would be possible for the government to put it through via decree. "Thank you all for giving us this vote of confidence. We are going to succeed in getting the country out of this very complex economic situation," Finance Minister Miguel Gomez said after the Senate passed the bill late on Monday night. SPENDING CUTS The budget cuts funds for the Special Jurisdiction for Peace (JEP) - the court created under a 2016 peace deal with the former Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) guerrillas to try rebel leaders and ex-soldiers for war crimes - by some 181 billion pesos, the finance ministry said in a statement, and reassigns that money to the defense ministry. The cut amounts to 23% of the court's budget, an even deeper reduction than had been previously expected. The court has said cuts will [USN:L6N45R12F TEXT:"limit investigations and trials"], make it difficult to provide victims with lawyers, psychological support and travel expenses, and put security schemes to protect victims and former combatants at risk. The operational budget for the Search Unit for Disappeared People, created under the peace deal to look for at least 137,000 people who vanished during the ongoing armed conflict, was cut by nearly 22%. The unit has warned a cut of that magnitude will threaten DNA collection from families and some 10,000 planned exhumations of remains. ($1 = 3,156.50 Colombian pesos)

item.description:

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独ＺＥＷ景気期待指数、10月28.1で予想下回る　6カ月ぶりに低下 10/20 18:52 配信

Linda Pasquini

[ベルリン ２０日 ロイター] - 欧州経済研究センター（ＺＥＷ）が２０日発表した１０月のドイツ景気期待指数は２８．１で予想以上に低下した。エネルギー価格の高止まりが個人消費や投資の重荷となり、６カ月ぶりの低下となった。

ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想は３０、前月は３４．７だった。

ＺＥＷのアヒム・ワムバッハ所長は「ドイツ経済は緩やかに停滞から抜け出しつつあるが、回復は自律的なものではない」と指摘。エネルギー価格の高止まりで個人消費と投資が引き続き低迷しており、実質所得を圧迫し生産コストを押し上げ、インフレの高止まりが長引いているとした。

先に発表された９月の生産者物価は、エネルギー価格の上昇で３年半ぶりの大幅な伸びとなった。原油・天然ガス価格の上昇が景気回復を鈍らせている。ワムバッハ氏は、ドイツ経済は緩やかに停滞から抜け出しつつあるものの、自律的な回復はなものではないと指摘した。

連立与党は、極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」の台頭で圧力が強まっている。１２日のバス労働相の辞任も不透明感を強めた。

ドイツ銀行リサーチのエコノミスト、フェリシタス・ヘンツェ氏は「最近の政治動向は、夏に発表された改革計画の迅速な実施を巡る不透明感を強めたとみられる」と述べた。

現況指数はマイナス３５．９で９月のマイナス４７．１から改善、改善幅は予想を上回った。

ドイツ経済省は今月、イラン戦争による経済への悪影響は懸念していたほどではないとして、２０２６年と２７年の経済成長率見通しを引き上げた。

ＶＰバンクのチーフエコノミスト、トーマス・ギッツェル氏は「受注残が高水準にあるため、産業界は当面は生産を増やすことができる。これが経済見通しの改善の理由でもある」と述べた。

国内経済は第２・四半期に０．３％成長した。ギッツェル氏は「予想外に底堅かった」上半期が２６年の成長を支えるはずだと指摘。第３・四半期はほとんど成長しなかったとみられるが、ＺＥＷ調査は第４・四半期にも新たな大きな成長の勢いは生じないことを示していると述べた。

調査は１０月１２─１９日に実施、アナリストと機関投資家１７８人の回答に基づく。

item.title: US envoy Witkoff to meet Putin, Trump presses Kyiv to settle
item.description: Zelenskiy told a news conference after the Oslo meeting that Ukraine was again receiving early warnings of Russian missile attacks.
item.dc:creator: Nerijus Adomaitis, Lina Golovnya, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: US envoy Steve Witkoff will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday after what a US official called "constructive" talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in Norway, as President Donald Trump said it was time for Ukraine to end the war. The US official said Ukraine brought forward new ideas and proposals to the Oslo talks, which also involved the leaders of Norway and Finland and European and NATO representatives, and that participants made "meaningful progress" toward a coordinated approach to engaging Russia. The official, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, said the talks covered "key elements of a comprehensive peace framework," including security guarantees for Ukraine, a post-war economic plan and a broader European security architecture. Witkoff would aim to "create a pathway toward direct trilateral and broader multilateral negotiations," the official said. Zelenskiy travelled to Oslo seeking to repair relations with Washington, which have sunk to new lows as Trump has courted Moscow. Kyiv has complained that Washington has withheld vital military support and intelligence. Zelenskiy told a news conference after the Oslo meeting and an earlier phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Ukraine was again receiving early warnings of Russian missile attacks. "Now it works, it's great," he said, adding he and Rubio had discussed supplies of Patriot missile interceptors as well as the satellite-based Starlink system, which Kyiv complained had stopped working when mounted on fast-moving objects such as drones. Trump's recent gestures toward Moscow, including a deal to buy Russian diesel and a waiver of new sanctions, sparked bipartisan pushback in the US Congress and worry in European capitals. Zelenskiy said he had discussed "Article 5-like" security guarantees, referring to the NATO stipulation that an attack on one ally is an attack on all. "I am thankful to the American side that they underlined again that it will be strong," he said. Zelenskiy reiterated that Ukraine hoped to discuss key issues on how to end the war during a trilateral meeting of leaders of Ukraine, Russia and the US. Norway's Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Stoere told the news conference the Oslo meeting had been good and constructive, while Finnish President Alexander Stubb added: "I think the (peace) process is back on track." Washington has denied deliberately hindering Ukraine's war effort. But Trump has repeatedly [USN:L6N4611D3 TEXT:"rebuked Zelenskiy"], and called for him to be [USN:L6N45W06G TEXT:"replaced"]. On Tuesday, Trump called on Ukraine to make a deal to settle the war, and said Moscow wanted to get it done. "Ukraine has to want to settle this war," he told reporters. Trump suggested Moscow had the upper hand in the fight because "Russia is a big machine — they just keep grinding forward, and that's what they've done. They've taken a very large piece of land." RUBIO SAYS US MISSILES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN DELIVERED YET The US under Trump has largely stopped providing weapons directly to Ukraine but lets European countries buy US weaponry on Kyiv's behalf under a program known as Prioritised Ukraine Requirements List (PURL). It has also provided intelligence and technology that Europe cannot match. A source familiar with the matter said most weapons deliveries under PURL continued to flow, but US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth had not approved Ukraine’s latest requests for Patriot interceptors. Rubio acknowledged on Tuesday that a consignment of interceptors bought by European countries for Ukraine may not have been delivered, but denied that the US had changed policy. "There has not been some deliberate political directive to go out and harm Ukraine," he said on a visit to India. Hegseth told reporters US policy toward Ukraine had not changed and stressed the need to maintain US stockpiles. "Certainly, with things like interceptors, we want to make sure our guys have the most possible as well," he said. He also said Washington had [USN:SPN4650B4 TEXT:"not pulled back Ukraine's ability to access Starlink"], which is owned by Elon Musk's SpaceX, and appeared to signal that the problem rested with corporate terms of service Kyiv needed to comply with. Musk has said Starshield, the military-grade version of SpaceX's Starlink communications system, is controlled by the US government and any limits on its use are ultimately up to Trump. Tuesday's Wall Street Journal cited US officials and people familiar with the matter as saying that Musk ordered the slowdown after consulting with Trump and other administration officials. Reuters [USN:L1N4610ZC TEXT:"reported"] earlier that the order to limit the service came from the White House. While US ties with Ukraine have deteriorated, Russia has stepped up attacks on Ukrainian cities, particularly targeting power stations and fuel, despite a call from Trump for both sides to spare each other's energy systems. Russia bombarded cities in western Ukraine overnight, targeting electricity systems and [USN:L1N4660DM TEXT:"knocking out power"] across swathes of the country that had previously been spared. Ukraine held back for several days last week from hitting Russian oil refineries in deference to Trump's request, but has resumed strikes after Russia showed no sign of complying. Both sides have also struck data centres. Trump has repeatedly condemned Ukrainian attacks on Russia while saying little about Russia's far more severe attacks on Ukraine. RUSSIAN ATTACKS Russia's defence ministry said on Tuesday it struck three cargo vessels in Ukraine's port of Reni and two other cargo vessels en route to Odesa. Russian forces also hit two logistics hubs, it said. Energy facilities were attacked in seven Ukrainian regions overnight, knocking out power, and the western Lviv region was struck again during the day. Russian drones also struck an energy facility in Kyiv on Tuesday, mayor Vitali Klitschko said, with authorities saying power was out in four districts. The deterioration of US-Ukraine relations began 10 days ago when Trump lifted sanctions on Russian diesel in a deal agreed with Putin. Trump said this would help reduce high fuel prices that have upset US voters ahead of midterm elections on November 3. At the weekend, Trump issued a broad waiver of tougher sanctions on Russia that were meant to have begun this week.

Zelenskyy travels to Oslo for new peace talks as pressure mounts from US to reach a deal with Russia

US envoy Steve Witkoff is expected in Oslo to take part in the talks with Norwegian Pm Jonas Gahr Støre and Finland’s President Alexander Stubb. Jared Kushner will take part online.

Olesia Safronova

20 October, 2026 03:19 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Volodymyr Zelenskyy in London on Oct. 14. Photographer: Betty Laura Zapata/Bloomberg

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is traveling to Norway for new peace talks as US pressure mounts for concessions from Kyiv to reach a deal with Russia.

US envoy Steve Witkoff is expected in Oslo to take part in the talks on Tuesday with Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre and Finland’s President Alexander Stubb, according to a government statement in Norway. Another US envoy, Jared Kushner, will take part online in the talks, the statement said.

The meeting’s being held amid escalating tensions between Zelenskyy and Donald Trump. The American president reiterated criticism of the Ukrainian leader on Monday after officials in Kyiv said they suspect the US is intermittently restricting intelligence sharing despite denials from Washington, allowing Russian missiles to strike Ukraine without warning.

Show Full Article

Zelenskyy “doesn’t know what he’s talking about” and should have settled the war a long time ago, Trump told reporters. “We’ve given a lot to Ukraine. They’ve given us nothing.”

Relations between Trump and Zelenskyy have soured since the US announced a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin this month for diesel supplies to American and global markets as the White House strives to cut surging fuel prices ahead of Nov. 3 midterm elections.

Trump followed that up by deferring sweeping new sanctions targeting Russian energy sales. That sparked criticism from lawmakers including in his own Republican party that he was helping Russia to continue financing the war that Putin started in February 2022.

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said in an interview with Bloomberg on Monday that Putin is seeking not only to defeat Ukraine, but to also undermine democracy in Europe. The key condition in the war was Ukraine’s territorial integrity “and that is not to dispute,” he said.

“I’m trying to convince Donald Trump each time I’m meeting him that this should be in his own interest,” Merz said. “A stable Europe, European continent, European Union as a partner in the world is something which is worthwhile for the Americans as well.”

The Ukrainian leader spoke by video call with Witkoff and Kushner, who is Trump’s son-in-law, on Sunday to discuss the war and possibilities for new talks. Zelenskyy said in a Bloomberg News interview on Sunday that the US side also planned to meet with Putin.

A Russian strike involving 16 ballistic missiles overnight on Sunday and Monday was the third time in the same week in which Ukraine was left without the usual advance warning it receives from US intelligence about incoming attacks. Ukraine has also accused the US of restricting access to SpaceX’s Starshield satellite technology.

How US Satellites Became Crucial to Ukraine’s Defense: Explainer

Zelenskyy said Tuesday he held “constructive” talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio about ballistic missile interceptors, early warning on attacks and the situation with Starshield “which needs to be restored.” They agreed to be in contact soon for an update, he said in a post on social media.

US officials have rebuffed accusations of any slowdown in intelligence to Ukraine. Trump last week said he didn’t order limitations on Ukraine’s access to Starshield.

Trump said Monday that “somebody else” instead of Zelenskyy should negotiate on behalf of Ukraine. He told reporters that “Russia frankly has been fine on Ukraine — they haven’t been doing much.”

(Updates with German chancellor in the seventh, eighth paragraphs. An earlier version of this story corrected the date to Tuesday in what is now the 11th paragraph.)

item.description:

item.content:encoded:
ＡＢＢ第3四半期、受注高が過去最高　データセンター向け好調 10/20 18:28 配信

スイスのエンジニアリング大手ＡＢＢのロゴ。2024年3月26日、パリ近郊で撮影。 REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

John Revill

[チューリヒ ２０日 ロイター] - スイスのエンジニアリング大手ＡＢＢは２０日、人工知能（ＡＩ）向けデータセンターへの投資ブームを背景に、第３・四半期の受注高が４０％増の１２０億ドルと、過去最高を記録したと発表した。

受注を大きく押し上げたのは、データセンターで使われる配電・冷却システムなどへの旺盛な需要だった。データセンター向けの受注は２倍超に増えた。

ＡＢＢは受注増を受け、通期見通しを小幅に引き上げた。比較可能ベースの売上高伸び率の予想を「１０％台前半」とした。従来は「１０％台の低い水準から１０％台前半」としていた。

第３・四半期の売上高は１４％増の９７億ドルだった。同社が集計したアナリスト予想の９７億４０００万ドルをわずかに下回った。営業ベースのＥＢＩＴＡ（利払い・税引き・無形資産償却前利益）は２４％増の２０億３０００万ドルと、アナリスト予想の２０億ドルをわずかに上回った。

ＡＢＢは同日、三菱電機との低圧配電事業の合弁会社の株式５１％を４億９５００万ドルで取得すると発表した。

ＡＢＢのモーテン・ウィーロッド最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「今回の取引により、世界有数の電化市場である日本で、低圧機器市場の首位に立つことになる。国内のデータセンター整備を含め、電力分野の幅広い潮流から恩恵を受けられる」と述べた。「アジア太平洋地域での事業拡大にも道が開ける」とした。

Bengaluru outpaces Mumbai, Gurugram in auto-tech funding race in 2026, bags 70% of sector investments

Bengaluru’s top position in 2026 YTD is influenced by several large funding rounds, led by Rapido’s $240 mn Series F round in May, report by Traxcn says.

Sharan Poovanna

20 October, 2026 02:57 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Representational image | Bloomberg

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

Bengaluru: Bengaluru accounts for $894 million, or 70 percent, of the $1.3 billion raised by auto-tech companies in the country in the Year To Date (YTD), with companies like ride-hailing platform Rapido attracting large venture capital (VC) funding. According to data intelligence firm Traxcn, Mumbai and Gurugram occupied the second and third spots at $107 million and $63 million respectively.

“India Auto Tech companies raised $1.3 bn across 97 rounds in 2026 year to date (2026 YTD), against $2.1B across 195 rounds in 2025,” said a report by Traxcn, released Monday.

Bengaluru’s top position was heavily influenced by several large funding rounds, led by Rapido’s $240 million Series F round in May, accounting for about 18 percent of the total funding, bringing its total to $798 million.

Show Full Article

The report includes only companies that provide software to the auto industry, Electric Vehicle (EV) solutions and firms that buy and sell automobiles online among others.

The promising numbers, however, do not necessarily mean India has withstood the global funding winter as the 2026 YTD investments are only some signs of stopping the downward spiral, data shows. With just over a quarter to go in this calendar year, there is hope that the numbers might hold up in comparison to corresponding years.

There has been a steady decline in investments into auto-tech companies from $3.1 billion (2021), $2.6 billion (2022), $2 v(2023) and a sharp decline in 2024 to $1.6 billion. There was, however, an upward trend in 2025 when companies in this sector raised $2.1 billion with 195 rounds of funding.

In 2026, there have been just 97 rounds of funding, indicating that money continues to pour into late-stage rounds rather than early-stage companies.

In 2026 (YTD), just $62.8 million went towards seed stage startups as against $126 million in 2025. Similarly, in 2026 early-stage startups accounted for $330 million as against $463 million last year.

Late-stage startups accounted for the lion’s share of Venture Capital (VC) funding inflows into the country, with $868 million this year as against $1.5 billion last year. Late-stage startups also saw lower number of funding rounds with 12 in 2026 (YTD) as against 20 rounds in 2025.

In 2025, auto-tech companies raised $2.1 billion, an increase from $1.6 billion in 2024. There has been a steady decline, however.

“Series C and later rounds made up eight of the 10 largest rounds in 2026 YTD, totalling $810 million. That is about 60 per cent of the funding total,” according to Traxcn.

Six of the eight companies are based in Bengaluru, reinforcing the city’s dominance in the startup and tech space. In total, Bengaluru has 1,234 companies in this space, including Ola Cabs, Ola Electric and Rapido among others with 955 of them funded.

Delhi has 825 companies with 725 funded ones while Mumbai has 490 funded companies, taking its total to 590. The other cities in the top eight are Hyderabad (523), Pune (517), Chennai (429), Gurugram (415) and Noida (292).

(Edited by Nardeep Singh Dahiya)

コアウィーブ売り、グローバル銀行のリスク限定的＝ＪＰモルガン 10/20 18:18 配信

コアウィーブのロゴが表示された画面。2026年7月20日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

Siddarth S

[２０日 ロイター] - ＪＰモルガンは２０日、エヌビディアが支援するクラウド企業コアウィーブの株式と債券が先週急落したことを受け、大半のグローバル銀行について同社へのエクスポージャーは限定的との評価を示した。

複数の米大手投資銀行や日本の三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ（ＭＵＦＧ）はコアウィーブに対して約１０億─３０億ドルのエクスポージャーを抱えている可能性がある一方、欧州やアジアのプレーヤーの大部分は５億ドル未満にとどまっているという。

ＪＰモルガンによると、その多くは「遅延引き出しタームローン」を通じて行われており、これらは主に特別目的事業体（ＳＰＶ）を通じて保有され、プロジェクトがマイルストーンを達成するにつれて資金が解放される仕組みとなっている。

アナリストらはリポートで「融資銀行の観点から見て、コアウィーブに対する銀行のエクスポージャーは適切に管理されており、担保も非常に充実している」と指摘。各行がＡＩ（人工知能）投資サイクルに対するエクスポージャーについて開示を限定しているため、この推定値は「簡略化された仮定」に基づいていると述べた。

ＪＰモルガンはコアウィーブに対し「オーバーウエート」の投資判断を付与しており、２０２７年末時点の目標株価を１２５ドルとしている。

各行が直面する主なリスクは、ＡＩインフラへの先行投資と、長期的に得られる収益とのミスマッチにあると指摘し、コアウィーブのフリーキャッシュフローは３０年までマイナスが続くと予想していると付け加えた。

item.title: Google Cloud services largely restored in UK; Revolut services back up in Singapore
item.description: A power outage at a Google Cloud data centre near London disrupted several UK banks and Revolut services, including in Singapore.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

Google Cloud services largely restored in UK; Revolut services back up in Singapore

A power outage at a Google Cloud data centre near London disrupted several UK banks and Revolut services, including in Singapore.

A pedestrian walks past the Google offices in London, Britain, August 14, 2025. REUTERS/Suzanne Plunkett

20 Oct 2026 05:11PM (Updated: 21 Oct 2026 06:33AM)

FAST

LONDON: A power outage at a Google Cloud data centre near London caused serious failures to services on Tuesday (Oct 20), leading to widespread disruptions for several UK banks. Google said in a service health update that most services had returned to normal by 12.10pm GMT (8.10pm, Singapore time), six hours after the incident began. "We are seeing the recovery of services for most workloads in europe-west2," the US tech giant said, referring to its London data centre. Google said its cloud services suffered an outage "due to a power event", in an incident that began at 6.08am GMT.

Services for the digital bank Revolut, including withdrawals from ATMs, bank transfers and bank card top-ups, were disrupted, which a source close to the matter attributed to the Google Cloud failures. UK lenders Lloyds and HSBC confirmed that customers faced issues with their banking services.  "We understand the root issues have been resolved, so we expect all our services to be back to normal soon," Lloyds said in a statement on Tuesday afternoon. Internet service tracker Downdetector indicated that hundreds of reports had been made of problems affecting business in the UK, including the property website Rightmove, delivery service DPD and the Royal Mail postal service. HSBC said its customers experienced "difficulties accessing our services", adding that it would "monitor the situation, which is also affecting other organisations". A Revolut spokesperson said the bank was "working to fix the issue since it was identified" and offered its apologies "to anyone affected and for any inconvenience caused". Multiple Revolut services in Singapore were also affected, including card payments, ATM withdrawals and currency exchange.  CNA’s checks at 6.30pm found that all 27 listed services on Revolut’s system status page were partially unavailable. The issues were first detected at about 3.50pm, according to the page.  As of 6.15am on Wednesday, all systems in Singapore were operational. In response to CNA's queries, a Revolut spokesperson confirmed that multiple services were affected by a service disruption and the company had been working to fix the issue since it was identified on Tuesday morning, UK time.  "We can confirm that all our customers’ money and data are safe," they added.

The company separately indicated, on background, that the disruption was linked to an outage at a third-party provider and was not limited to Revolut.

Related:

YouTrip services operating normally after 'major outage'

Commentary: An Amazon outage has rattled the internet – why the ‘cloud’ needs to change

RELIANCE ON HYPERSCALERS Google said it would publish a full incident report in the coming days.  The outage has renewed concerns over the global reliance on cloud providers, which offer businesses on-demand IT resources without heavy investment in expensive server farms. Local providers have seen their share of the market shrink in recent years and been captured by foreign giants known as "hyperscalers". A global outage at Amazon's cloud services last year disrupted many online services for video games, business and transport firms and made part of the internet inaccessible for several hours. Only three major hyperscalers - Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services - have the infrastructure to handle vast amounts of data needed by businesses at scale in the UK, said University of Surrey cybersecurity professor Alan Woodward. These centres remain "susceptible to localised infrastructure failures", which can have significant knock-on effects when so many businesses depend on just a handful of providers, he added. He said the problem is "intensifying with the AI boom" as demand for hyperscalers rises, meaning "we are becoming more reliant on these few massive entities".

Source: Reuters/aj/dc

item.title: ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion in Nvidia chip orders
item.description: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered over 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards, but the chipmaker may struggle to meet demand amid US export restrictions on China ...
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion in Nvidia chip orders

ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion in Nvidia chip orders ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered over 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards, but the chipmaker may struggle to meet demand amid US export restrictions on China

(Photo: Reuters)

Reuters 5 min read Last Updated : Oct 20 2026 | 9:38 PM IST

Listen to This Article

ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million of Nvidia's new RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards with a collective sticker price of over $35 billion, two people familiar with the matter said, in a rush for a less powerful but export-compliant chip amid US restrictions on trade with China.   US-based chipmaker Nvidia has told customers and partners it cannot guarantee that it can fill the orders because demand from Chinese technology companies far exceeds planned production, the two sources and a third person familiar with the matter said. They requested anonymity because they are not authorised to speak to the media.

The RTX PRO 5500 is a workstation chip designed for powerful professional computers rather than the large data centre clusters that use Nvidia's most advanced AI processors. But it is among the most powerful Nvidia chips that are still available to Chinese buyers.   Nvidia's Blackwell-based B300 data centre chip is not allowed to be sold to Chinese buyers under US export controls, while exports of its Hopper-based H200 are reviewed on a case-by-case basis and are subject to licensing conditions.   One source said Nvidia told partners they might receive only 5 per cent to 10 per cent of the quantities requested. Another said the company had indicated it could produce no more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 cards globally in 2027. Total orders from customers in China have exceeded 6 million, two of the sources said.

Also Read

Amazon launches TorchNeuron to challenge Nvidia's AI chip dominance

Samsung to tap TSMC technology for Nvidia's custom memory chips: Report

Would halt chip supply to buyers who develop unsafe AI, says Nvidia CEO

Alibaba unveils $450 Qwen AI glasses in expanding push into gadgets

Beyond Nvidia: Why tech firms are turning to custom chips for AI inference

The three Chinese tech giants' orders are for cards priced at about $11,400 each, two of the sources said, giving them a potential combined value of more than $35 billion.   The scale of the orders, which have not been previously reported, underscores the ongoing appetite among Chinese companies for Nvidia hardware despite the US curbs.   Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang has said the restrictions reduced Nvidia's share of China's AI data centre chip market from a near monopoly to effectively nothing. But demand for the RTX PRO 5500 suggests Nvidia retains a sizeable potential market in China through less powerful products that may still be available.

The surge in demand also highlights how US restrictions have tightened computing power supplies in the world's second-largest economy as Chinese companies race to develop cutting-edge AI models and propel Beijing's effort to deploy the technology across its industries.   Washington's curbs have pushed Chinese firms towards domestic suppliers, while Beijing has encouraged the use of homegrown chips.   Huawei, in particular, has gained market share, though Chinese chipmakers have generally struggled to match leading American products, partly because separate restrictions have limited access to the foreign equipment that is used to make the most advanced semiconductors.   An Nvidia spokesperson said Chinese producers of workstation chips and cards have experienced "unprecedented growth since 2022," when the curbs were first imposed.

"US firms continue to be restricted by a combination of outdated US export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly a half decade ago, and China's own limit on US imports," the spokesperson said.   ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent did not respond to requests for comment.   The US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security, which oversees the export controls, and China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology did not respond to requests for comment.   An export-compliant alternative   The RTX PRO 5500 is less powerful than Nvidia's H200 and B300 chips, which are designed to be linked in large numbers for the most demanding AI training and deployment workloads.

Chinese companies are seeking to use the cards primarily for AI inference, or running trained models to generate chatbot responses, the three sources said. Inference generally requires less computing power than training models on massive datasets.   The RTX PRO 5500 is similar to the RTX 6000D in performance, according to product specifications seen by Reuters.   Nvidia launched the RTX 6000D in the middle of last year as a reduced-capability product designed to meet US export restrictions. Major Chinese tech firms initially showed little interest, with some declining to place orders, Reuters reported last year.   At the time, buyers viewed the chips as overly expensive given their capabilities and hoped Washington would eventually allow sales of more powerful Nvidia processors.

Those expectations have faded as restrictions have remained in place and AI computing capacity has remained scarce, making the RTX PRO 5500 a more attractive substitute, two of the sources said.   Supply squeeze   Nvidia's inability to promise full deliveries reflects both a surge in demand and its manufacturing priorities, two of the sources said.   Starting in 2027, Nvidia is expected to devote much of its capacity at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co to Rubin, its next-generation platform for large-scale data centres, rather than products like the RTX PRO 5500, two of the sources said. TSMC declined to comment.   Nvidia has told customers to expect early samples in December, with commercial deliveries beginning in the first quarter of 2027, they added.

The RTX 6000D has since been discontinued and its market price in China has doubled, one of the sources said.   In an October 13 filing, Shenzhen-listed fintech and AI computing services company Tansun Technology said it had agreed to buy 20,000 RTX PRO 5500 cards from an unidentified counterparty.   It cautioned that supply shortages, industry demand and overseas technology controls could delay deliveries or reduce volumes.
